# 100mini

> Instant HTML hosting with no signup. Paste AI-generated HTML (including Claude
> artifacts and ChatGPT output) or upload a .html/.zip file and get a live,
> shareable link in about 30 seconds. Free. Anonymous uploads auto-destroy after
> 7 days; logged-in users get 5 permanent pages free, and can set an expiry
> (1 hour–30 days), cap views, or create a one-time burn-after-reading link.

## Start here
- [Publish a page (web)](https://100mini.com/): paste HTML or drag-drop a file
- [Publish a Claude artifact as a live link](https://100mini.com/claude-artifact-to-link)
- [Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/dmmhkdcmifenlihbbhihkagnebgiekep)
- [Agent skill — publish without a browser or login](https://100mini.com/skill/100mini-upload)

## Product
- [Free tools](https://100mini.com/freetool): Claude-to-Link, Markdown to HTML, any document to Markdown, ID photo, and more
- [Games](https://100mini.com/games)
- [Case library](https://100mini.com/showcase)
- [Learning Square](https://100mini.com/square)
- [Alternatives & comparisons](https://100mini.com/alternatives): 100mini vs Netlify Drop, Tiiny Host, CodePen, Vercel, GitHub Pages, and AI-native artifact sharing

## Facts
- Formats: .html, .htm, .zip (ZIP must contain index.html as the entry point)
- Anonymous limit: 5 MB per page, auto-destroyed after 7 days
- Logged in: 5 permanent pages free; larger files and custom links use in-app points
- Expiry & burn (free, logged in): set an expiry (1h / 1d / 7d / 30d / custom ≤30d), a max view count (1 / 3 / 5 / 10 / ∞), or a one-time burn-after-reading link that deletes its content on first open and leaves only a playful "digital ashes" notice. Crawlers and link previews do not count as views.
- Safety: every hosted page runs in a Content-Security-Policy sandbox with a phishing-prevention banner; content is deleted on expiry or burn (a minimal content-free metadata record may be retained for abuse prevention)
- Languages: en, zh, es, pt, fr
- Pricing and limits: https://100mini.com/pricing.md
